A lone **bold** line renders as a heading and a block of '- ' lines renders as a list, escaped, so Aayush's
markdown in docs/tokens-learned.md shows no raw asterisks or dashes.
source: @pytest.mark.req("TOK-07") def test_what_i_learned_bold_title_and_bullets(browser, server): """A lone **bold** line renders as a heading and a block of '- ' lines renders as a list, escaped, so Aayush's markdown in docs/tokens-learned.md shows no raw asterisks or dashes.""" text = "**Title**\n\n- One x.\n- Two." p = open_page(browser, server, data={**D, "learned": text}) assert p.locator("#learned h3").all_inner_texts() == ["Title"] assert p.locator("#learned li").all_inner_texts() == ["One x.", "Two."] assert p.locator("#learned b").count() == 0 p.close()
